# Camp Resource: Wall-Mounted Oven

- 2 min read

__Wall-Mounted Oven__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bb4f233fe15b44fc84bd3da2cba230f7~mv2.png)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6c30500865604338b893bdae63df625e~mv2.png)

Image Credit: MsBlobby

*"With the Wall-mounted Oven, it's meat time, all the time."*

__Overview__

## **__Function__**

__Function__

Produces raw meat

| Item Produced | Drop Rate | 
| Brahmin Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Chicken Thigh | 9.09091% | 
| Dog Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Fox Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Iguana Bits | 9.09091% | 
| Mole Rat Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Mutant Hound Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Radroach Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Radstag Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Raw Wolf Meat | 9.09091% | 
| Squirrel Bits | 9.09091% | 

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: None
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 6

__Crafting Requirements__

- 5x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds of mixed raw meat

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop: 
 - Wall-Mounted Oven: 500 Atoms
 - Bountiful Food Bundle: 1300 Atoms (includes Wall-Mounted Oven)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Links:

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
